description: Patterns for search, experimentation, adaptation, and solution discovery
detailedDescription: Exploration and discovery patterns balance trying uncertain alternatives with exploiting known good choices. The collection includes curiosity-driven search, bandit strategies, evolutionary optimization, and reinforcement learning for environments where useful behavior must be discovered through feedback.

bestPractices: Define safe exploration boundaries and rollback conditions
Separate offline evaluation from guarded online experiments
Track regret, coverage, and downstream impact rather than reward alone
commonPitfalls: Exploring directly in high-risk production decisions
Optimizing a proxy reward that diverges from user value
Ignoring delayed effects and changing environments
whenToUse: The best action is initially uncertain and feedback arrives over time
The candidate space is too large for exhaustive search
Controlled experimentation is permitted and measurable

name: Exploration & Discovery
whyImportant: Systems that only repeat known strategies cannot adapt to new conditions, while unconstrained exploration can be costly or unsafe. These patterns make that trade-off explicit.
